articles.title: Securing AI agent identity with X.509 PKI on AWS
articles.excerpt: Learn how to secure multi-agent AI systems with cryptographic identity using Keyfactor EJBCA and AWS services. This reference architecture combines signed request envelopes, user-signed delegation assertions, RFC 8693 audience-scoped tokens, and real-time OCSP revocation to prove agent identity and prevent request forgery across agent-to-agent and MCP tool calls.

image.alt: Three-layer PKI authentication architecture showing credential flow between the user, agents, and the MCP tool server

articles.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Denodo and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
